text:
jess: Heads-up — non-prod eu-west-1 warmpool is failing to boot GPU nodes after the audit egress rollout. Logs show KMS decrypt 403s and nodes stuck in JOIN_PENDING. Anyone seen this?

mike: yep i'm seeing the same in the infra dashboard — join rate = 0 for the pool. grabbed a couple of agent logs.

olivia: jumping on logs now. @audit-bot when was the new egress policy applied to non-prod?

audit-bot: policy 'egress-audit-enforce' applied to non-prod namespace at 2025-06-18T09:12:03Z by ryan. Action: DENY outbound except to SIEM collector. No explicit allow for KMS privatelink endpoints found.

ryan: i deployed a tighter egress rule to reduce noisy flows — intent was to still allow KMS via privatelink. looks like i mis-tagged the endpoint role so the allow didn't match the keystore subnet. my bad, looking into fix now.

mike: can we hotfix by whitelisting KMS endpoints (or the keystore IPs) temporarily? right now autoscaler is stalled and warmpool warmup is blocked.

olivia: quick workaround: add an allow in the firewall for the keystore privatelink hostnames from the warmpool subnets. example (short-term):

```
# temporary, do not keep long-term
iptables -I OUTPUT -d kms.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com -j ACCEPT
```

But SG/NACL change is preferable.

sre-oncall: triage update — confirmed ~120 nodes stuck in JOIN_PENDING across two AZs. Starting a targeted firewall rollback to allow KMS and audit collector traffic from warped subnets. ETA ~10m.

jess: note on cost/ops: if nodes fallback to internet-based keystore we will incur NAT bandwidth + spike in audit logs. @ryan keep that in mind for rollback timing.

ryan: understood. i'm editing the privatelink policy now to include the keystore service principal and to correct the tag matcher for the non-prod keystore endpoint. will push in a minute.

deploy-bot: rollout started: non-prod firewall change cf-5521 (canary 5% -> 100%) — initiated by ryan.

mike: nodes are starting to join — +37 JOINED in last 2m. still seeing KMS 403s from a couple of older agent builds (v0.9.3).

olivia: opening an infra PR to add a mandatory `keystore:get` smoke check in the onboarding e2e so we don't ship these silently. also will add a small doc on privatelink tagging gotchas.

jess: :thumbsup: keep the temporary allow until e2e passes and the privatelink policy is validated. i'll own a short blameless postmortem.

audit-bot: audit event recorded: policy-change by ryan; ticket created INF-2498.

ryan: i'll follow up with a short playbook in eng-platform about privatelink IAM/policy pitfalls and how to validate endpoint tags before rollout. thanks for the quick response team.

mike: recommend we add a monitoring alert: new-join rate < 5/min for 3m after warmpool scale + any KMS 403 spikes -> pager. i'll file the alert in MON-432.

jess: agreed. closing loop when MON-432 and INF-2498 are linked.
